blocks.text: The U.S. midterm elections may reshape American support for the Philippines. But protecting our maritime interests requires more than a defense alliance. It also demands stronger institutions, better coordination, and the ability to turn resources into results. What happens in Washington can have consequences in Philippine waters. The November 2026 U.S. midterm elections are shaping a new political landscape, with early results pointing to significant Democratic gains in Congress. While the final composition of both chambers remains subject to the completion and certification of election results, the emerging political shift deserves attention in Manila. For the Philippines, the stakes are considerable. […]... Keep on reading: Who Controls Washington Matters but How We Govern Our Seas Matters More
